from cache import make_key
from service import score

store = {}
def dummy_compute():
    return 'result'

# test 1: compute when key missing
store.clear()
res1 = score(store, 'job1', 'prof1', 'c1', dummy_compute)
assert res1 == 'result'
assert store == {('job1', 'prof1', 'c1'): 'result'}

# test 2: reuse when all three inputs same
res2 = score(store, 'job1', 'prof1', 'c1', dummy_compute)
assert res2 == 'result'
assert store == {('job1', 'prof1', 'c1'): 'result'}

# test 3: compute when profile changes (others same)
store.clear()
res3 = score(store, 'job1', 'prof2', 'c1', dummy_compute)
assert res3 == 'result'
assert store == {('job1', 'prof2', 'c1'): 'result'}

# test 4: reuse when profile changes but different key
res4 = score(store, 'job1', 'prof2', 'c1', dummy_compute)
assert res4 == 'result'
assert store == {('job1', 'prof2', 'c1'): 'result'}

# test 5: compute when criteria changes
store.clear()
res5 = score(store, 'job1', 'prof1', 'c2', dummy_compute)
assert res5 == 'result'
assert store == {('job1', 'prof1', 'c2'): 'result'}

# test 6: compute when text changes
store.clear()
res6 = score(store, 'job2', 'prof1', 'c1', dummy_compute)
assert res6 == 'result'
assert store == {('job2', 'prof1', 'c1'): 'result'}

# test 7: mixed changes all three
store.clear()
res7 = score(store, 'job2', 'prof2', 'c2', dummy_compute)
assert res7 == 'result'
assert store == {('job2', 'prof2', 'c2'): 'result'}

# test 8: None inputs allowed; they affect caching if changed

res8a = score(store, None, None, None, dummy_compute)
assert res8a == 'result'
assert store == {(None, None, None): 'result'}
store.clear()
res8b = score(store, None, 'prof1', None, dummy_compute)
assert res8b == 'result'
assert store == {(None, 'prof1', None): 'result'}

print('All tests passed')
